# Akaunting

> > Free, open-source accounting software for small businesses, freelancers, and accountants with invoicing, expense tracking, multi-company management, and extensible app marketplace.

Akaunting is a cloud-based accounting platform designed for SMBs and freelancers seeking an affordable alternative to traditional accounting software. The platform emphasizes community-driven development, multilingual support (50+ languages), and integrations with popular payment processors and business tools like Shopify, Stripe, and Amazon Business.
